threat_event: Ransomware encrypts business systems across the fleet (WMS, ERP, file shares, station business networks) during a refueling outage, extending the outage
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Energy is a priority target; about 17,500 endpoints; outage contractors bring their own laptops; Station 4 gaps (R-003)
existing_controls: 24x7 SOC; EDR at Stations 1 to 3; PAM; immutable backups; annual DR tests; cyber insurance
treatment_plan: Station 4 EDR and SIEM (POAM-004); WMS outage-mode RTO (POAM-010); contractor segment enforcement; enterprise ransomware exercise with the disclosure committee (POAM-013)
key_risk_indicator: EDR coverage; mean time to contain; tier-1 DR test results

threat_event: Attacker on the plant business network pivots toward CDAs through portable media, maintenance equipment, or a misconfigured boundary device
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Business networks are the outer defensive level; portable media and contractor equipment cross toward CDAs during outages
existing_controls: One-way data transfer devices; portable media kiosks; CSP controls; no remote access to CDAs; NRC inspection IP 71130.10
treatment_plan: Close kiosk bypass (POAM-015); include pivot scenario in station tabletops; monthly boundary device checks
key_risk_indicator: Kiosk scans per media item; boundary device test results

threat_event: Attacker enters through Station 4's flat network or the prior owner's vendor VPN and reaches fleet systems
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Station 4 on legacy directory, flat business network, vendor VPN outside PAM (P07 SC-7, AC-17)
affected_asset_or_process: Station 4 business network; DC-1 link; WMS
existing_controls: Firewall between Station 4 and DC-1; legacy antivirus
treatment_plan: Segment the Station 4 network and retire the VPN (POAM-009); federate identities (POAM-003); EDR and SIEM (POAM-004)
key_risk_indicator: Station 4 hosts with EDR; identities federated; VPN sessions

threat_event: Outage contractor accounts stay active after departure and are misused
threat_source: Former contractor or attacker using stolen credentials
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Manual removal at Stations 2 and 3; bulk end-date extensions (P07 AC-2, AC-2(3))
treatment_plan: Automated removal from badge-out events (POAM-001); stop bulk extensions (POAM-002); contract notice clause (POAM-006)
owner: Director of Identity and Access Management
key_risk_indicator: Contractor accounts active after departure; days to removal

threat_event: Wireless sensor gateways with cellular links create an unanalyzed path next to plant equipment at Station 4
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Gateways installed without a 73.54(b)(1) analysis or design change cyber review; default passwords (P07 IA-5)
affected_asset_or_process: Station 4 business network; non-safety equipment; AI-001 data path
existing_controls: Gateways read sensors only; no CDA connection found in the walkdown
treatment_plan: Disconnect gateways from the business network; complete the analysis and design change review; change passwords; CAP entry (POAM-011; POAM-018)
key_risk_indicator: Unanalyzed wireless devices found in walkdowns

threat_event: Compromise of the WMS changes clearance records or surveillance schedules
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: WMS is a single instance; integrity checks run nightly, not in real time
affected_asset_or_process: WMS clearance and surveillance modules; BP-06
existing_controls: Field independent verification of clearances; nightly integrity checks; MFA; PAM
treatment_plan: Automated integrity response (SI-7(2), SI-7(5)); real-time alert on clearance edits outside work hours
key_risk_indicator: Integrity check exceptions; off-hours clearance edits

threat_event: One person writes and approves the same clearance and an isolation error goes undetected until field verification
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 9 Station 3 users hold both roles; system does not block self-approval (P07 AC-5)
affected_asset_or_process: WMS clearance module; Station 3 work control
existing_controls: Independent field verification in station procedure
treatment_plan: Remove dual roles and add a system block (POAM-005)

threat_event: Clearance approvals under a shared kiosk login cannot be traced to a person
threat_source: Workforce practice under outage time pressure
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Station 2 outage control center used a shared login in spring 2026 (P07 AU-10)
treatment_plan: Badge-tap sign-in at kiosks; disable shared accounts (POAM-007)

threat_event: An untested WMS rule change mis-schedules Technical Specification surveillances
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 4 of 40 sampled scheduling rule changes lacked documented tests (P07 CM-3)
existing_controls: Operations approval; weekly surveillance look-ahead by station coordinators
treatment_plan: Mandatory test record and automated block (POAM-008)

threat_event: WMS outage during a refueling outage lasts longer than 4 hours and extends the outage
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 2026 DR test took 11 hours against an 8-hour RTO; outage mode untested (P05 DEP-01)
existing_controls: Edge servers; paper clearance procedure; warm standby
treatment_plan: Automate standby failover; test outage mode before the next outage (POAM-010)

threat_event: Safeguards Information is disclosed through a networked copier or an unsanitized SGI workstation
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Networked copier in the Station 4 SGI room; 2 SGI workstations without sanitization records (P03)
existing_controls: Locked SGI room; stand-alone SGI computers; SGI training
treatment_plan: Replace copier with a stand-alone unit; sanitize and record (POAM-023)

threat_event: Cyber security plan details, CDA inventories, or network diagrams are stolen from business file shares
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Security-related information is kept on business systems with restricted folders; some copies in personal drives
existing_controls: Restricted folders; labels; DLP on email
treatment_plan: Sweep for security-related information outside restricted folders; DLP rules for CDA inventory patterns
key_risk_indicator: Security-related files found outside restricted folders

threat_event: A material incident is disclosed late or inaccurately because the materiality process has not been exercised on a plant scenario with NRC notifications
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Playbook not exercised with the disclosure committee on an NRC-reportable scenario; NRC publishes event notification reports
treatment_plan: Tabletop with the disclosure committee on 2026-11-19 using the P08 scenario (POAM-013)

threat_event: NRC notification under 73.77 is late because SOC reports to the FBI or CISA are not linked to station clocks
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Corporate SOC reports to other agencies without telling the station (P03 G-048)
existing_controls: Station cyber teams on call; notification procedure
treatment_plan: Add a station notification step to every SOC external report (POAM-013)
key_risk_indicator: SOC external reports with station notice

threat_event: Cyber program deficiencies are entered in the corrective action program later than 24 hours
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 2 of 25 sampled entries were late (P03 G-050)
treatment_plan: Daily CAP screening of SOC cases tagged as station-related (POAM-013)

threat_event: Generation Dispatch Center BES Cyber Systems are compromised and dispatch communications are lost
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: High impact BES Cyber Systems with inter-control-center links
existing_controls: ESP with EAPs; intermediate system with MFA; backup GDC; 2025 Regional Entity audit
treatment_plan: Maintain; add CIP-015-1 network monitoring planning before its effective date
owner: Vice President, Generation Dispatch and Energy Marketing

threat_event: Vendor remote access to Station 4 low impact switchyard interface devices does not meet CIP-003-9 Attachment 1 Section 6
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Prior owner's vendor VPN path; no method to detect malicious communications for vendor sessions
treatment_plan: Route through the fleet intermediate system with detection (POAM-025)
key_risk_indicator: Vendor sessions outside the intermediate system

threat_event: Outage contractor laptops bring malware onto the plant business network
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Up to 1,500 contractor devices per outage; contractor segment rules vary by station
existing_controls: Contractor segment; network access control at Stations 1 to 3
treatment_plan: Health check portal for contractor devices before outage start

threat_event: The WMS software vendor is compromised or ships a malicious update
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Single EAM vendor; updates installed by the company within 30 days
existing_controls: Vendor SOC 2 review; test environment; staged rollout
treatment_plan: Require software bills of materials and signed packages in the 2027 renewal

threat_event: The M&D analytics vendor has a breach that exposes SL-1 client and fleet data
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No SOC report and no security addendum (P07 SA-9)
existing_controls: Data limited to equipment readings and work history
treatment_plan: Security addendum and SOC 2 Type 2 or equivalent by renewal (POAM-016)
owner: Vice President, Monitoring and Diagnostics Services

threat_event: The shared industry personnel access database is unavailable during an outage and contractor badging stops
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Industry-wide single point of failure (P05 DEP-13)
treatment_plan: Accepted; manual fallback documented in the outage plan

threat_event: Business email compromise leads to a fraudulent PPA settlement or vendor payment
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: High-value payments (PPA invoices about $400 million a month)
treatment_plan: Payment change verification in the ERP workflow

threat_event: Employee and contractor personal information is exfiltrated (payroll, badging, access authorization data)
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Large personal data sets; Station 4 legacy systems
treatment_plan: Data minimization in outage spreadsheets (POAM-024); DLP for SSN patterns
key_risk_indicator: Records with SSNs outside approved systems

threat_event: Access authorization data is mishandled in outage coordinators' spreadsheets
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Exports to spreadsheets for outage planning (P03 G-067)
treatment_plan: Replace exports with a restricted report (POAM-024)

threat_event: The background screening vendor has a breach of applicant data
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Contract lacks the 73.56(m)(3) confidentiality clause (P03 G-066)
treatment_plan: Amend contract (POAM-024)

threat_event: Dose records are lost or corrupted and cannot be restored
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Restore never tested (P05 DEP-06)
treatment_plan: Restore test with record count and checksum verification (POAM-019)

threat_event: The dosimetry client portal is compromised and client worker identifiers and dose data are exposed
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Internet-facing portal; some clients still send SSNs
treatment_plan: Replace SSNs with client worker IDs for new clients; penetration test before the SOC 2 period
key_risk_indicator: Portal findings; SSN fields in use

threat_event: Export-controlled reactor technology is accessed by unauthorized foreign persons (vendor or provider staff)
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Work packages and drawings in cloud and SaaS systems
existing_controls: US-person administration for tagged accounts; provider US-person support
treatment_plan: Annual export control access review

threat_event: A privileged business administrator misuses access
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Privileged access to WMS and network devices
existing_controls: PAM recording; access authorization behavioral observation
treatment_plan: Accepted with current controls

threat_event: A zero-day in an internet-facing VPN or firewall is exploited
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Edge devices at DC-1 and the Station 4 legacy VPN
treatment_plan: Retire the Station 4 VPN (POAM-009); 72-hour emergency patch target
key_risk_indicator: Days to patch critical edge flaws

threat_event: A cloud misconfiguration exposes WMS or EDMS data
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Guardrails block common errors
treatment_plan: Accepted with current controls

threat_event: An identity platform outage blocks access to all business systems
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Single identity platform
existing_controls: Break-glass accounts; second region; met DR test
treatment_plan: Maintain; quarterly break-glass tests
owner: Director of Identity and Access Management

threat_event: Station 4's single wide area network carrier fails
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: One carrier (P05 DEP-07)
treatment_plan: Second carrier (POAM-021)

threat_event: The prior owner's legacy WMS at Station 4 fails and recovery takes up to 48 hours
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Agreement RTO 48 hours against the 8-hour BIA RTO; untested (P05 DEP-24)
treatment_plan: Weekly export of open clearances and surveillance schedule; migration (POAM-022)

threat_event: The transition services agreement ends before the Station 4 migration is complete
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Migration planned 2027-05; agreement ends 2027-06-30
existing_controls: Extension option in the agreement (one 6-month term)
treatment_plan: Exercise extension option decision by 2027-01-31 (POAM-022)

threat_event: Default passwords on business network devices are used to gain a foothold (found on sensor gateways)
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 3 gateways with manufacturer defaults (P07 IA-5 new finding)
existing_controls: Network access control at Stations 1 to 3
treatment_plan: Change passwords; default credential scan in every walkdown (POAM-011)

threat_event: Vendor media opened at warehouse receiving introduces malware
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Kiosk bypass at Station 3 warehouse (P07 MP-7)
treatment_plan: Kiosk at receiving; training (POAM-015)

threat_event: A hurricane disrupts Station 1 and DC-1 in Florida at the same time
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Station 1 and DC-1 in the same state
existing_controls: DC-2 replicas; cloud workloads in other regions
treatment_plan: Move EDMS primary to DC-2 during hurricane warnings

threat_event: Unpatched WMS edge servers and Station 4 hosts are exploited
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Patch freeze during outages; Station 4 scan coverage about 70% (P07 RA-5, SI-2)
treatment_plan: Outage freeze exception process; Station 4 scan coverage (POAM-014)

threat_event: Attacks at Station 4 go undetected because its logs are not in the SIEM
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No SIEM feed or network detection at Station 4 (P07 AU-6, SI-4)
treatment_plan: SIEM collectors and network detection (POAM-004)

threat_event: Unapproved generative AI tools are used with security-related or export-controlled information
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Public AI tools are attractive for drafting
treatment_plan: Block unapproved AI domains; approved tools list (POL-05 4.8)

threat_event: AI-001 misses a failure precursor on equipment whose failure can trip a unit
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Model validated fleet-wide only; advisory use (P10)
affected_asset_or_process: AI-001; balance-of-plant equipment in Maintenance Rule scope
existing_controls: Maintenance Rule monitoring and preventive maintenance unchanged; engineer review
treatment_plan: Station and equipment-class validation (POAM-020)
owner: Vice President, Monitoring and Diagnostics Services
key_risk_indicator: Missed known events; recall by class

threat_event: AI-001 performs unevenly across stations or equipment classes
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Fleet-level metrics only (P10)
treatment_plan: Subgroup testing plan (P10 section 6; POAM-020)
owner: Vice President, Monitoring and Diagnostics Services

threat_event: The condition report screening assistant (AI-004) under-rates a safety-significant condition
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Pilot; human screening committee reviews all reports
existing_controls: Human screening of every report during the pilot
treatment_plan: Keep human screening; compare AI and human ratings monthly

threat_event: Resume screening AI (AI-011) produces adverse impact
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Vendor feature switched on in 2026
treatment_plan: Ranking disabled until review and adverse impact analysis

threat_event: AI use cases operate without committee review (4 of 12)
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Use cases entered through vendor features and pilots before intake controls
treatment_plan: Reviews by 2026-11-30 (POAM-020)

threat_event: The generative AI drafting assistant introduces an error into a work package or procedure
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Drafts reviewed by qualified staff; not used for safety-related procedures
existing_controls: Qualified reviewer sign-off; AI label on drafts
treatment_plan: Accepted with controls; re-review at 12 months

threat_event: An ERP access control fails SOX testing
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Role changes during Station 4 integration
treatment_plan: Accepted with current controls

threat_event: The Item 106 disclosure describes controls that are not operating as described
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Program changes faster than the annual filing
existing_controls: Disclosure committee review; Internal Audit testing
treatment_plan: Internal Audit tests each Item 106 statement before the 2027 filing

threat_event: Immutable backups are deleted or encrypted by an attacker
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Backups in separate accounts with write-once locks
existing_controls: Separate accounts; write-once locks; DC-2 copy
treatment_plan: Quarterly deletion attempt test

threat_event: A denial-of-service attack takes down the dosimetry client portal
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Internet-facing portal
existing_controls: DDoS protection; reports by secure email as fallback
treatment_plan: Accepted

threat_event: A lost laptop exposes export-controlled or personal data
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Full-disk encryption on all laptops
treatment_plan: Accepted

threat_event: One SL-1 client's plant data is shown to another client
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Multi-tenant M&D platform
treatment_plan: Automated tenant isolation test in each release
owner: Vice President, Monitoring and Diagnostics Services

threat_event: A dose calculation change produces wrong dose results for SL-2 clients
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Algorithm parameters changed under the lab quality system
existing_controls: NVLAP quality system; reference dosimeter checks
treatment_plan: Dual review of algorithm changes recorded in change management

threat_event: A plant-specific phishing campaign that shows pre-operational planning is not reported to the NRC within 8 hours
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: SOC triage does not always flag plant-specific lures to stations
treatment_plan: Lure screening criteria shared with station cyber teams (POAM-013)

threat_event: Counterfeit or tampered IT equipment is installed on a station business network
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Equipment bought through approved channels
treatment_plan: Maintain; annual reseller review

threat_event: GDC vendor contracts lack CIP-013 notification and coordination terms
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 2 legacy contracts not yet amended (P07 SR-6)
treatment_plan: Amend at renewal (POAM-017)

threat_event: A one-way device or historian replica misconfiguration creates a two-way path
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Hardware one-way devices; maintenance under CSP
existing_controls: Hardware design; post-maintenance tests; CSP change control
treatment_plan: Maintain; monthly verification test

threat_event: The payroll SaaS is unavailable at a pay date
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Single vendor
treatment_plan: Accepted

threat_event: Loss of key nuclear cyber security staff weakens the station programs
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Small teams at each station; competitive market
treatment_plan: Succession plan and two qualified backups per station

threat_event: An insider with unescorted access uses digital means to sabotage plant equipment
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Access authorization and behavioral observation programs
existing_controls: Access authorization; two-person rules for key CDA changes; CSP controls
treatment_plan: Maintain; include insider scenario in station drills

threat_event: The energy scheduling platform is unavailable and imbalance charges accrue
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Single SaaS platform (P05 DEP-21)
treatment_plan: Annual fallback drill
owner: Vice President, Generation Dispatch and Energy Marketing

threat_event: A future acquisition repeats the Station 4 integration gaps
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Growth strategy includes buying more stations
treatment_plan: Security integration funding required in deal approval

threat_event: Pending NRC rule changes (73.54, 73.77) lead to premature procedure changes before a final rule
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Proposed rule 91 FR 38928 (2026-06-26) not final
treatment_plan: Accepted; no change until a final rule and its effective date
